EscUp-L.name: Esc Up
EscUp-L.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-L.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

SwordMastery-L.name: Sword Mastery
SwordMastery-L.description: Needed to learn sword skills. Passively increases damage dealt with swords.

Axes.name: Axes
Axes.description: Needed to learn axe skills. Passively increases damage dealt with axes.

Counter.name: Counter
Counter.description: Chance to counter physical damage, even if damage was blocked.

2-Hit-L.name: 2-Hit
2-Hit-L.description: Normal weapon attacks have a chance of hitting twice.
2-Hit-L.descriptionInGame: Normal weapon attacks have a chance of hitting twice.

Cleaver.name: Cleaver
Cleaver.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy.

Tornado.name: Tornado
Tornado.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy and enemies adjacent to them.
Tornado.descriptionInGame: A whirling sword skill that slashes adjacent enemies.

Allslash.name: Allslash
Allslash.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to 2 to 4 enemies. Each enemy can only be hit once.
Allslash.descriptionInGame: A sword slash that hits a group of enemies 2-4 times.

Hypercut.name: Hypercut
Hypercut.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy.

RiskCut.name: Risk Cut
RiskCut.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. The damage increases when the Landsknecht's HP falls under certain thresholds.
RiskCut.descriptionInGame: Sword slash that gains strength as the landsknecht loses HP.

Deathaxe.name: Deathaxe
Deathaxe.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy.

Silencer.name: Silencer
Silencer.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict head bind.
Silencer.descriptionInGame: An axe strike with a chance of binding the enemy's head.

Brawn.name: Brawn
Brawn.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy.
Brawn.descriptionInGame: Slow-yet-powerful crushing blow with an axe.

LifeAxe.name: Life Axe
LifeAxe.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. The damage decreases when the Landsknecht's HP falls under certain thresholds.
LifeAxe.descriptionInGame: Axe strike whose power correlates to the landsknecht's current HP.

Stunner.name: Stunner
Stunner.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict stun.
Stunner.descriptionInGame: An axe strike that puts the enemy off-balance.

Blazer.name: Blazer
Blazer.description: A single target Fire attack on an enemy that was just dealt fire damage.
Blazer.descriptionInGame: Follows fire magic with a flaming sword or axe slash.

Freezer.name: Freezer
Freezer.description: A single target Ice attack on an enemy that was just dealt ice damage.
Freezer.descriptionInGame: Follows ice magic with a freezing sword or axe slash.

Shocker.name: Shocker
Shocker.description: A single target Volt attack on an enemy that was just dealt volt damage.
Shocker.descriptionInGame: Follows volt magic with a shocking sword or axe slash.

WarCry.name: War Cry
WarCry.description: Increases the Landsknecht's physical attack at the cost of their physical defense for 5 turns.
WarCry.descriptionInGame: Increase attack power at the expense of physical defense.

Unbind-L.name: Unbind
Unbind-L.description: Removes bindings from one party member.
Unbind-L.descriptionInGame: Removes bindings from one party member.

Mine-L.name: Mine
Mine-L.description: Mine for materials at item points.
Mine-L.descriptionInGame: Mine for materials at item points.

AllOut.name: Force: All Out
AllOut.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to all enemies.
AllOut.descriptionInGame: Powerful, charging slash that targets all enemies.

EscUp-S.name: Esc Up
EscUp-S.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-S.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Bows.name: Bows
Bows.description: Needed to learn Bow skills. Passively increases damage dealt with Bows.

Ambush.name: Ambush
Ambush.description: Passively increases the chance of your party getting a preemptive attack on enemies. Will not work for guaranteed blindside encounters.
Ambush.descriptionInGame: Increase the chances of getting a preemptive attack.

Sagacity.name: Sagacity
Sagacity.description: Passively decreases the chance of enemies blindsiding your party. Will not work for guaranteed blindside encounters.
Sagacity.descriptionInGame: Lessens the chances of enemy preemptive attacks.

1stHit.name: 1st Hit
1stHit.description: Passively gives the Survivalist a chance to act first in a turn.
1stHit.descriptionInGame: Chance of acting first in the turn order, regardless of speed.

Trueshot.name: Trueshot
Trueshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy.

Multihit.name: Multihit
Multihit.description: Deals 2 instances of ranged STR-based Stab damage to random enemies. Can hit the same enemy multiple times.
Multihit.note: The targets are predetermined when the Survivalist attacks. If an enemy was targeted to take multiple hits, but dies before the rest of those hits come out, they will simply disappear and will not get redirected to other enemies.

Sleeper.name: Sleeper
Sleeper.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict sleep.
Sleeper.descriptionInGame: Fire a special arrow that may put an enemy to sleep.

Number.name: Number
Number.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict paralysis.
Number.descriptionInGame: Fire a special arrow that may paralyze an enemy.

Poisoner.name: Poisoner
Poisoner.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict poison.
Poisoner.descriptionInGame: Fire a special arrow that may poison an enemy.

Apollon.name: Apollon
Apollon.description: When used, the Survivalist fires off a shot into the air. Two turns later, it will come down at the start of the turn, dealing ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy.
Apollon.descriptionInGame: This ultimate shot takes 3 turns for its full effect to be felt.
Apollon.note: The skill cannot be used again until the shot comes down. If the Survivalist is incapacitated on the turn the shot comes down, it will not hit the enemy.

1stTurn.name: 1st Turn
1stTurn.description: Forces the targeted party member to act first.
1stTurn.descriptionInGame: The targeted party member may act first in battle.

Slowstep.name: Slowstep
Slowstep.description: Forces the targeted party member to act last.
Slowstep.descriptionInGame: The targeted party member may act last in battle.

Baitstep.name: Baitstep
Baitstep.description: Increases the Survivalist's evasion and the chance of being targeted by enemies for 5 turns.
Baitstep.descriptionInGame: Draw enemy attacks while increasing evasion rate.

Velocity.name: Velocity
Velocity.description: Increases the Survivalist's AGI for 5 turns.
Velocity.descriptionInGame: Drastically increase one's speed with advanced moves.

Patrol-S.name: Patrol
Patrol-S.description: Can only be used on the field. Lowers damage taken from damage tiles for a set number of steps.
Patrol-S.descriptionInGame: Lower damage taken from hazard floors for a limited time.

Stalker.name: Stalker
Stalker.description: Can only be used on the field. Lowers the encounter rate by lowering the danger value of tiles for a set number of steps.
Stalker.descriptionInGame: Cautious steps reduce the chances of enemy encounters.

Foesense.name: Foesense
Foesense.description: Can only be used on the field. Reveals all FOEs on the map for a set number of steps.
Foesense.descriptionInGame: Draw the location of FoEs by sensing enemy presences.

Chop-S.name: Chop
Chop-S.description: Chop wood for materials at item points.
Chop-S.descriptionInGame: Chop wood for materials at item points.

Take-S.name: Take
Take-S.description: Gather plants for materials at item points.
Take-S.descriptionInGame: Gather plants for materials at item points.

Mine-S.name: Mine
Mine-S.description: Mine for materials at item points.
Mine-S.descriptionInGame: Mine for materials at item points.

Airwalk.name: Force: Airwalk
Airwalk.description: Increases the party's evasion by for 5 turns.
Airwalk.descriptionInGame: Increase the party's evasion rate with fancy footwork.

EscUp-P.name: Esc Up
EscUp-P.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-P.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

ShieldMastery.name: Shield Mastery
ShieldMastery.description: Needed to learn shield skills. Passively decreases the damage the Protector takes from all damage types.

Aegis.name: Aegis
Aegis.description: If the Protector dies, this passive has a chance to revive them with 1 HP. Only works once per battle. Won't activate if the Protector gets killed by instant death.
Aegis.descriptionInGame: Preparedness for death makes it possible to survive once per battle.

EnGarde-P.name: En Garde
EnGarde-P.description: Passively gives the Protector a chance to reduce any instance of damage they take by 50%.
EnGarde-P.descriptionInGame: Chance of automatically blocking enemy attacks.

HPRegen.name: HP Regen
HPRegen.description: Passively restores the Protector's HP at the end of each turn.
HPRegen.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of HP after every turn in battle.

Riskwall.name: Riskwall
Riskwall.description: Passively decreases the amount of damage the Protector takes from all damage types. The damage reduction increases when the Protector's HP falls under certain thresholds.
Riskwall.descriptionInGame: Defense increases as the protector loses HP.

Smite.name: Smite
Smite.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict arm bind. The defense value on the Protector's shield is used for Weapon Attack in the damage formula.
Smite.descriptionInGame: Powerful shield strike that may bind an enemy's arms.

FrontGuard.name: Front Guard
FrontGuard.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the front row takes from physical attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. Every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels.
FrontGuard.descriptionInGame: Shield skill that may take physical damage in the front line's place.

RearGuard.name: Rear Guard
RearGuard.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the Back row takes from physical attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. Every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels.
RearGuard.descriptionInGame: Shield skill that may take physical damage in the back line's place.

FullGuard.name: Full Guard
FullGuard.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the entire party takes from physical attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. Every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels.
FullGuard.descriptionInGame: Shield skill that may take physical damage in the party's place.

1Guard.name: 1 Guard
1Guard.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage one party member takes from physical attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. Every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels.
1Guard.descriptionInGame: Shield skill that may heavily reduce physical damage for one party member.

FireWall.name: Fire Wall
FireWall.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the entire party takes from fire attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. From levels 1 through 9, every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels. At level 10, the skill will always activate. At levels 1 through 7, the damage is simply reduced. At levels 8 through 10, the effects of the attack are completely nullified, meaning that any status effects attached to those attacks will not take effect. At levels 9 and 10, the damage is not nullified, but ends up being absorbed and heals the party instead.
FireWall.descriptionInGame: Protects the party from fire attacks for 1 turn.

IceWall.name: Ice Wall
IceWall.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the entire party takes from ice attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. From levels 1 through 9, every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels. At level 10, the skill will always activate. At levels 1 through 7, the damage is simply reduced. At levels 8 through 10, the effects of the attack are completely nullified, meaning that any status effects attached to those attacks will not take effect. At levels 9 and 10, the damage is not nullified, but ends up being absorbed and heals the party instead.
IceWall.descriptionInGame: Protects the party from ice attacks for 1 turn.

VoltWall.name: Volt Wall
VoltWall.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the entire party takes from volt attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. From levels 1 through 9, every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels. At level 10, the skill will always activate. At levels 1 through 7, the damage is simply reduced. At levels 8 through 10, the effects of the attack are completely nullified, meaning that any status effects attached to those attacks will not take effect. At levels 9 and 10, the damage is not nullified, but ends up being absorbed and heals the party instead.
VoltWall.descriptionInGame: Protects the party from volt attacks for 1 turn.

ManaWall.name: Mana Wall
ManaWall.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce the amount of damage the entire party takes from elemental attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. Every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels. At levels 1 through 4, the damage is simply reduced. At level 5, the effects of the attack are completely nullified, meaning that any status effects attached to those attacks will not take effect. The damage taken is also absorbed and heals the party instead.
ManaWall.descriptionInGame: Protects the party from all elemental attacks for 1 turn.

Fortify.name: Fortify
Fortify.description: Increases the Protector's physical defense for 5 turns.
Fortify.descriptionInGame: Digs in for ironclad defense against physical damage.

Provoke.name: Provoke
Provoke.description: Increases the Protector's physical defense and the chance of being targeted by enemies for 5 turns.
Provoke.descriptionInGame: Increase physical defense and divert the enemy's attention to you.

Parry.name: Parry
Parry.description: At the start of the turn, the Protector prepares to reduce any damage they take from any melee physical attacks for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Protector dies. Every time the skill activates, the chance of it activating again is reduced. The base activation rate is 100% at all levels.
Parry.descriptionInGame: Await the enemy's attack to parry it and negate the damage.

Refresh-P.name: Refresh
Refresh-P.description: Dispels certain status ailments from one party member. Which ailments are dispelled depends on the skill's level. Cannot dispel petrification, no matter how high its level is. Dispels certain status ailments from the entire party. Which ailments are dispelled depends on the skill's level. The higher the skill's level, the more ailments that can be dispelled. Cannot dispel petrification, no matter how high its level is.
Refresh-P.descriptionInGame: Removes status ailments from one party member.

Flee.name: Flee
Flee.description: When used, the Protector has a chance to escape from the battle at the start of the turn. If you visited multiple floors during one trip to the Labyrinth, there is a chance to warp back to the previous floor and the last set of stairs used. Otherwise the skill only functions as another escape method. The warp aspect works even if you get cornered by a FOE. If the skill is used on the first turn of a preemptive attack, the escape and warp activation rate is always 100%, no matter what level the skill is at. The escape rate and warp activation rates have separate checks. Cannot work in boss battles, no matter what the circumstances.
Flee.descriptionInGame: Escape from battle to the previous floor.

Mine-P.name: Mine
Mine-P.description: Mine for materials at item points.
Mine-P.descriptionInGame: Mine for materials at item points.

Painless.name: Force: Painless
Painless.description: The Protector sets up the perfect defense at the start of the turn, nullifying any damage taken and prevents any status effects or binds from landing until the end of the turn. Does not affect debuffs or buff dispels.
Painless.descriptionInGame: Nullifies all damage, status ailments, and binds to the party for one turn.

EscUp-D.name: Esc Up
EscUp-D.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-D.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Whips.name: Whips
Whips.description: Needed to learn whip skills. Passively increases damage dealt with whips.

SwordMastery-D.name: Sword Mastery
SwordMastery-D.description: Needed to learn sword skills. Passively increases damage dealt with swords.

Antisick.name: Antisick
Antisick.description: Passively increases the Dark Hunter's resistance to ailments.
Antisick.descriptionInGame: Intensive training allows the user to resist status ailments.

Antibind.name: Antibind
Antibind.description: Passively increases the Dark Hunter's resistance to binds.
Antibind.descriptionInGame: Indomitable will allows the user to resist being bound.

Anaconda.name: Anaconda
Anaconda.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict poison.
Anaconda.descriptionInGame: Whip slash with a chance of poisoning the enemy.

Shackles.name: Shackles
Shackles.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict leg bind.
Shackles.descriptionInGame: Whip slash with a chance of binding the enemy's legs.

Cuffs.name: Cuffs
Cuffs.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict arm bind.
Cuffs.descriptionInGame: Whip slash with a chance of binding the enemy's arms.

Gag.name: Gag
Gag.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict head bind.
Gag.descriptionInGame: Whip slash with a chance of binding the enemy's head.

Ecstasy.name: Ecstasy
Ecstasy.description: If used against an enemy that is fully bound, a massive amount of melee STR-based Cut damage is dealt. Otherwise, the Dark Hunter only deals 100% damage.
Ecstasy.descriptionInGame: Whip slash that does incredible damage to totally bound enemies.

Climax.name: Climax
Climax.description: Targets one enemy. If they are under a certain HP threshold, they are instantly killed, and the Dark Hunter is healed for any HP they had remaining. If the enemy is over the HP threshold, the skill will always miss. If the enemy is under the HP threshold, but is immune to instant death, the Dark Hunter only deals 100% melee STR-based Cut damage to them instead. Accuracy is only checked for in that case. Climax does not have a success rate. It cannot miss if the target is under the HP threshold and is not immune to instant death.
Climax.descriptionInGame: Whip slash that may kill and drain enemies with low HP.

Hypnos.name: Hypnos
Hypnos.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict sleep.
Hypnos.descriptionInGame: Sword stab with a chance of putting the enemy to sleep.

Nerve.name: Nerve
Nerve.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict paralysis.
Nerve.descriptionInGame: Sword stab at the enemy's nerves with a chance of paralyzing it.

Mirage.name: Mirage
Mirage.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict confusion.
Mirage.descriptionInGame: Sword stab at the enemy's skull with a chance of confusing it.

Drain.name: Drain
Drain.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. The Dark Hunter is healed for a portion of the damage they deal.
Drain.descriptionInGame: Sword stab that drains the enemy's HP through the blade.

Petrify.name: Petrify
Petrify.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict petrification.
Petrify.descriptionInGame: Sword stab at the enemy's muscles with a chance to petrify.

Bait.name: Bait
Bait.description: At the start of the turn, the Dark Hunter sets up a trap. If they or any party member adjacent to them get attacked with a physical attack, the Dark Hunter has a chance of dealing melee STR-based Cut damage to the attacker. The counters will still activate even if the damage taken was nullified through the use of methods such as Painless.
Bait.descriptionInGame: Uses comrades on either side as bait for physical attacks.

Magibait.name: Magibait
Magibait.description: At the start of the turn, the Dark Hunter sets up a trap. If they or any party member adjacent to them get attacked with a elemental attack, the Dark Hunter has a chance of dealing melee STR-based Cut damage to the attacker. The counters will still activate even if the damage taken was nullified through the use of methods such as Painless.
Magibait.descriptionInGame: Uses comrades on either side as bait for elemental attacks.

Unbind-D.name: Unbind
Unbind-D.description: Removes binds from one party member.
Unbind-D.descriptionInGame: Removes bindings from one party member.

Racket.name: Racket
Racket.description: Can only be used on the field. Any non-red FOEs within a certain range will be lured to the tile this skill gets used on. Once they reach that tile, they will be stunned for a set duration.
Racket.descriptionInGame: Tuneless yawp that draws FoEs to the spot where it is used.

Chop-D.name: Chop
Chop-D.description: Chop wood for materials at item points.
Chop-D.descriptionInGame: Chop wood for materials at item points.

Dominate.name: Force: Dominate
Dominate.description: Binds an enemy's head, arms, and legs with a 10000% success rate. Nothing in the game is immune to any bind, so it is guaranteed to work. Has a 1% speed modifier.
Dominate.descriptionInGame: Concentrated attack completely binds a single enemy.

EscUp-M.name: Esc Up
EscUp-M.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-M.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Healer.name: Healer
Healer.description: Needed to learn healing skills. Passively increases the amount of HP restored through non-fixed sources.

PatchUp.name: Patch Up
PatchUp.description: Passively restores a percentage of each party member's max HP at the end of each battle.
PatchUp.descriptionInGame: Restores a certain amount of HP after battle.

TPRegen.name: TP Regen
TPRegen.description: Passively restores the Medic's TP at the end of each turn.
TPRegen.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of TP after every turn in battle.

Scavenge-M.name: Scavenge
Scavenge-M.description: Passively increases the drop rate for each item the enemy has. The increase is additive and stacks with other instances of Scavenge.
Scavenge-M.descriptionInGame: Increase the chance of finding items after battle.

Cure-M.name: Cure
Cure-M.description: Restores a small amount of HP to one party member.
Cure-M.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of HP.

Healing-M.name: Healing
Healing-M.description: Restores a medium amount of HP to one party member.
Healing-M.descriptionInGame: Restores a medium amount of HP.

FullHeal-M.name: Full Heal
FullHeal-M.description: Restores full HP to one party member.

Salve-M.name: Salve
Salve-M.description: Restores a small amount of HP to the entire party.
Salve-M.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of HP to the entire party.

Salve2-M.name: Salve 2
Salve2-M.description: Restores a medium amount of HP to the entire party.
Salve2-M.descriptionInGame: Restores a medium amount of HP to the entire party.

Salve3.name: Salve 3
Salve3.description: Restores full HP to the entire party.
Salve3.descriptionInGame: Restores full HP to the entire party.

Revive.name: Revive
Revive.description: Brings a dead party member back to life.
Revive.descriptionInGame: Bring the dead back to life.

Unbind-M.name: Unbind
Unbind-M.description: Removes bindings from one party member.
Unbind-M.descriptionInGame: Removes bindings from one party member.

Freedom.name: Freedom
Freedom.description: Removes bindings from the entire party.
Freedom.descriptionInGame: Removes bindings from the entire party.

Refresh-M.name: Refresh
Refresh-M.description: Dispels certain status ailments from the entire party. Which ailments are dispelled depends on the skill's level. The higher the skill's level, the more ailments that can be dispelled.
Refresh-M.descriptionInGame: Removes status ailments from one party member.

Purify.name: Purify
Purify.description: Dispels certain status ailments from the entire party. Which ailments are dispelled depends on the skill's level. The higher the skill's level, the more ailments that can be dispelled. Cannot dispel petrification, no matter how high its level is.
Purify.descriptionInGame: Removes status ailments from the entire party.

Caduceus.name: Caduceus
Caduceus.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict stun.
Caduceus.descriptionInGame: A heavy staff strike with a chance of stunning the enemy.

CPR.name: CPR
CPR.description: Places a buff on the entire party that has a chance of reviving them with 1 HP when they die. The buff lasts for 5 turns. Once the party member gets revived, the buff is dispelled.
CPR.descriptionInGame: Chance that party members will survive mortal blows with 1 HP.

Phoenix.name: Phoenix
Phoenix.description: When used, the Medic's life is sacrificed to heal and revive the rest of the party.
Phoenix.descriptionInGame: Sacrifice oneself to revive and heal allies, remove blindness, and possibly remove binds.

Patrol-M.name: Patrol
Patrol-M.description: Can only be used on the field. Lowers damage taken from damage tiles for a set number of steps.
Patrol-M.descriptionInGame: Lower damage taken from hazard floors for a limited time.

Take-M.name: Take
Take-M.description: Gather plants for materials at item points.
Take-M.descriptionInGame: Gather plants for materials at item points.

HealingTouch.name: Force: Healing Touch
HealingTouch.description: Fully heals and revives the entire party, along with dispelling any status ailments they have. Has no effect on binds or stuns. Has a speed modifier of 1%.
HealingTouch.descriptionInGame: Special healing arts restore party's HP and status.

EscUp-A.name: Esc Up
EscUp-A.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-A.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

FireUp.name: Fire Up
FireUp.description: Needed to learn Fire spells. Passively increases damage dealt with Fire spells.

IceUp.name: Ice Up
IceUp.description: Needed to learn Ice spells. Passively increases damage dealt with Ice spells.

VoltUp.name: Volt Up
VoltUp.description: Needed to learn Volt spells. Passively increases damage dealt with Volt spells.

PhysUp.name: Phys Up
PhysUp.description: Needed to learn physical spells. Passively increases damage dealt with physical spells.

Analysis.name: Analysis
Analysis.description: When the Alchemist strikes a weakness with one of their spells, the enemies in question take even more damage. Only affects spells. A weakness is counted as a damage resistance of 110% or above.
Analysis.descriptionInGame: Increase damage when using elements the enemy is weak to.

Fire.name: Fire
Fire.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Fire damage to one enemy.
Fire.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth fire to attack the enemy.

Flame.name: Flame
Flame.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Fire damage to one enemy. A 1.5x damage multiplier is applied to the Alchemist's base damage when using these skills.
Flame.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth flame to attack the enemy.

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Fire damage to all enemies.
Inferno.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth an inferno to attack the enemy.

Ice.name: Ice
Ice.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Ice damage to one enemy.
Ice.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth ice to attack the enemy.

Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Ice damage to one enemy. A 1.5x damage multiplier is applied to the Alchemist's base damage when using these skills.
Freeze.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth icicles to attack the enemy.

Cocytus.name: Cocytus
Cocytus.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Ice damage to all enemies.
Cocytus.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth a blizzard to attack the enemy.

Volt.name: Volt
Volt.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Volt damage to one enemy.
Volt.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth voltage to attack the enemy.

Thunder.name: Thunder
Thunder.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Volt damage to one enemy. A 1.5x damage multiplier is applied to the Alchemist's base damage when using these skills.
Thunder.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth lightning to attack the enemy.

Thor.name: Thor
Thor.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Volt damage to all enemies.
Thor.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth divine thunder to attack the enemy.

Blades.name: Blades
Blades.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Cut damage to all enemies.
Blades.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth blade-like gusts of wind to slash all enemies.

Gravity.name: Gravity
Gravity.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Bash damage to all enemies.
Gravity.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth extreme pressures to bash all enemies.

Piercing.name: Piercing
Piercing.description: Deals ranged TEC-based Stab damage to all enemies.
Piercing.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth sharp objects to pierce all enemies.

Megido.name: Megido
Megido.description: Deals ranged TEC-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. A 1.5x damage multiplier is applied to the Alchemist's base damage when using this skill.
Megido.descriptionInGame: Conjure forth an almighty shockwave to attack an enemy.

Return.name: Return
Return.description: Can only be used in the field. Teleports the party to the last Geomagnetic Field they used. Has no effect if they came in from the entrance of the Labyrinth.
Return.descriptionInGame: Teleport the party back to the last used Geomagnetic Field.

Chop-A.name: Chop
Chop-A.description: Chop wood for materials at item points.
Chop-A.descriptionInGame: Chop wood for materials at item points.

Eschaton.name: Force: Eschaton
Eschaton.description: Deals ranged TEC-based untyped damage to all enemies. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. A 1.5x damage multiplier is applied to the Alchemist's base damage when using this skill. Has a spell power of 200. Has a speed modifier of 300%. Has an accuracy modifier of 300%.
Eschaton.descriptionInGame: Release a forbidden almighty spell to destroy all enemies.

EscUp-T.name: Esc Up
EscUp-T.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-T.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Songs.name: Songs
Songs.description: Needed to learn song skills. Passively increases speed of song skills.

Divinity.name: Divinity
Divinity.description: Passively increases the amount of EXP the party gains after battle. Stacks with other instances of Divinity.
Divinity.descriptionInGame: Increase experience for the entire party.

Bravery.name: Bravery
Bravery.description: Increases the party's damage output for the duration of the battle. The damage buff is applied directly to the party members' base damage, so untyped attacks such as the Alchemist's Megido skill are also affected.
Bravery.descriptionInGame: Pulsing beat that increases the party's strength.

Shelter.name: Shelter
Shelter.description: Decreases the amount of damage the party takes for the duration of the battle.
Shelter.descriptionInGame: Triumphant anthem that increases the party's defense.

Mercury.name: Mercury
Mercury.description: Increases the party's AGI for the duration of the battle.
Mercury.descriptionInGame: High-tempo piece that increases the party's speed.

Stamina.name: Stamina
Stamina.description: Increases the party's maximum HP for the duration of the battle. When cast, the party's current HP will not be set to the new maximum.
Stamina.descriptionInGame: Tribal rhythm that increases the party's maximum HP.

Blaze.name: Blaze
Blaze.description: Imbues one party member's weapon with Fire, enabling them to deal Fire damage with their normal attacks.
Blaze.descriptionInGame: Song that imbues a party member's weapon with fire.

Frost.name: Frost
Frost.description: Imbues one party member's weapon with Ice, enabling them to deal Ice damage with their normal attacks.
Frost.descriptionInGame: Song that imbues a party member's weapon with ice.

Shock.name: Shock
Shock.description: Imbues one party member's weapon with Volt, enabling them to deal Volt damage with their normal attacks.
Shock.descriptionInGame: Song that imbues a party member's weapon with voltage.

Ifrit.name: Ifrit
Ifrit.description: Places a buff on the entire party that increases their resistance to Fire and places a debuff on all enemies that decreases their resistance to Fire. The buff lasts for the duration of the battle, while the debuff lasts for 5 turns.
Ifrit.descriptionInGame: Party's fire resistance raised while the enemy's decreases.

Ymir.name: Ymir
Ymir.description: Places a buff on the entire party that increases their resistance to Ice and places a debuff on all enemies that decreases their resistance to Ice. The buff lasts for the duration of the battle, while the debuff lasts for 5 turns.
Ymir.descriptionInGame: Party's ice resistance raised while the enemy's decreases.

Taranis.name: Taranis
Taranis.description: Places a buff on the entire party that increases their resistance to Volt and places a debuff on all enemies that decreases their resistance to Volt. The buff lasts for the duration of the battle, while the debuff lasts for 5 turns.
Taranis.descriptionInGame: Party's volt resistance raised while the enemy's decreases.

Erasure.name: Erasure
Erasure.descriptionInGame: A startling song that erases the enemy's status benefits.

Nihilo.name: Nihilo
Nihilo.descriptionInGame: A startling song that erases status benefits from all enemies.

Health.name: Health
Health.description: Places a buff on the entire party that reduces the chances of enemies inflicting status ailments on the party for the entire battle.
Health.descriptionInGame: Requiem that increases party's defense against status ailments.

Recovery.name: Recovery
Recovery.description: Places a buff on the entire party that increases the rate at which they recover from status effects.
Recovery.descriptionInGame: Blessed aria that recovers party status ailments more quickly.

Danger.name: Danger
Danger.description: Increases the encounter rate by increasing the danger value of tiles for a set number of steps.
Danger.descriptionInGame: Cacophonous song that increases the enemy encounter rate.

Luring.name: Luring
Luring.description: Any non-red FOEs within a certain range will be lured to the tile this skill gets used on.
Luring.descriptionInGame: Tuneless yawp that draws FoEs to the spot where it is used.

Slumber.name: Slumber
Slumber.description: Any non-red FOEs within a certain range will be stunned for a set duration.
Slumber.descriptionInGame: Gentle melody that puts FoEs to sleep for a limited time.

Take-T.name: Take
Take-T.description: Gather plants for materials at item points.
Take-T.descriptionInGame: Gather plants for materials at item points.

Crusade.name: Force: Crusade
Crusade.description: Applies three separate buffs to the entire party, buffing attack, defense, and max HP. For the purposes of overriding buffs, the ATK Up buff is placed first, the DEF Up buff is placed second, and the HP MAX Up buff is placed last. Meaning that any new buff will immediately override the ATK Up buff first.
Crusade.descriptionInGame: Secret song that increases the party's attack, defense, and max HP.

EscUp-R.name: Esc Up
EscUp-R.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-R.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Shiraha.name: Shiraha
Shiraha.description: Passively gives the Ronin a chance to nullify any damage they take. Does not count as evasion, and is completely independent of the Ronin's stats or any evasion boosts they may have.
Shiraha.descriptionInGame: Potentially nullifies any attack directed at the user.

Overhead.name: Overhead
Overhead.description: Needed to learn Overhead stance skills. Passively increases damage dealt with Overhead skills.
Overhead.descriptionInGame: Needed to learn Overhead stance skills.

Seigan.name: Seigan
Seigan.description: Needed to learn Seigan stance skills. Passively increases damage dealt with Seigan skills.
Seigan.descriptionInGame: Needed to learn Seigan stance skills.

Iai.name: Iai
Iai.description: Needed to learn Iai stance skills. Passively increases damage dealt with Iai skills.
Iai.descriptionInGame: Needed to learn Iai stance skills.

Clarity.name: Clarity
Clarity.description: Passively increases the Ronin's evasion. The evasion boost increases when the Ronin's HP falls under certain thresholds.
Clarity.descriptionInGame: Evasion rate increases as the ronin loses HP.

Sayageki.name: Sayageki
Sayageki.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy.
Sayageki.descriptionInGame: Bash an enemy with the katana's sheath.

Zamba.name: Zamba
Zamba.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy.
Zamba.descriptionInGame: Strong katana slash from over the head.

Midareba.name: Midareba
Midareba.description: Deals multiple instances of melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy.
Midareba.descriptionInGame: Repeated katana slashes against a single enemy.

Orochi.name: Orochi
Orochi.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut+Fire damage to one enemy.
Orochi.descriptionInGame: A fiery, overhead katana slash directed at a single enemy.

Kienzan.name: Kienzan
Kienzan.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut+Fire damage to all enemies.
Kienzan.descriptionInGame: Fiery, overhead katana slashes directed atall enemies.

Koteuchi.name: Koteuchi
Koteuchi.description: Deals melee STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict arm bind.
Koteuchi.descriptionInGame: Piercing katana attack that may bind an enemy's arms.

Getsuei.name: Getsuei
Getsuei.description: Deals melee STR-based Stab damage to one enemy.
Getsuei.descriptionInGame: Straight katana stab from the Seigan stance.

Raizuki.name: Raizuki
Raizuki.description: Deals melee STR-based Volt+Stab damage to one enemy.
Raizuki.descriptionInGame: Volt-charged katana stab against a single enemy.

Minakata.name: Minakata
Minakata.description: Deals melee STR-based Volt+Stab damage to all enemies.
Minakata.descriptionInGame: Volt-charged katana stabs against all enemies.

Kubiuchi.name: Kubiuchi
Kubiuchi.description: Deals melee STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict instant death.
Kubiuchi.descriptionInGame: Katana slash that may result in an instant kill.

Nukeuchi.name: Nukeuchi
Nukeuchi.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy.
Nukeuchi.descriptionInGame: Powerful katana stab from the Iai stance.

Hyosetsu.name: Hyosetsu
Hyosetsu.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut+Ice damage to one enemy.
Hyosetsu.descriptionInGame: Icy katana slash against a single enemy.

Hosoyuki.name: Hosoyuki
Hosoyuki.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut+Ice damage to all enemies.
Hosoyuki.descriptionInGame: Icy katana slash against all enemies.

DeadLaw.name: Dead Law
DeadLaw.description: Increases the Ronin's damage output at the cost of decreasing their defenses for 5 turns.
DeadLaw.descriptionInGame: Increase attack power at the expense of physical defense.

Mine-R.name: Mine
Mine-R.description: Mine for materials at item points.
Mine-R.descriptionInGame: Mine for materials at item points.

Issen.name: Force: Issen
Issen.description: Deals 500% melee STR-based Cut damage to all enemies. Has a 50% chance to inflict instant death. Has a 1% speed modifier. Has a 100% accuracy modifier.
Issen.descriptionInGame: Slash all enemies in an attempt to kill with a single stroke.

EscUp-H.name: Esc Up
EscUp-H.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-H.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Scavenge-H.name: Scavenge
Scavenge-H.description: Passively increases the drop rate for each item the enemy has. The increase is additive and stacks with other instances of Scavenge.
Scavenge-H.descriptionInGame: Increase the chance of finding items after battle.

Sapping.name: Sapping
Sapping.description: Decreases all enemies' damage output for 5 turns.
Sapping.descriptionInGame: Curse that decreases all enemies' strength.

Frailty.name: Frailty
Frailty.description: Decreases all enemies' defense for 5 turns. This is a resistance multiplier, and untyped attacks will not deal more damage against enemies with this debuff.
Frailty.descriptionInGame: Curse that decreases all enemies' defense.

Leaden.name: Leaden
Leaden.description: Decreases all enemies agility for 5 turns.
Leaden.descriptionInGame: Curse that decreases all enemies' speed.

Dampen.name: Dampen
Dampen.description: Adjusts an enemy's damage resistances to remove any resistances or immunities they have for 5 turns.
Dampen.descriptionInGame: Curse that decreases an enemy's special resistances.

Cranial.name: Cranial
Cranial.description: Attempts to inflict head bind on one enemy.
Cranial.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of binding an enemy's head.

Abdomen.name: Abdomen
Abdomen.description: Attempts to inflict arm bind on one enemy.
Abdomen.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of binding an enemy's arms.

Immobile.name: Immobile
Immobile.description: Attempts to inflict leg bind on one enemy.
Immobile.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of binding an enemy's legs.

Blinding.name: Blinding
Blinding.description: Attempts to inflict blind on all enemies.
Blinding.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of blinding all enemies.

Poison.name: Poison
Poison.description: Attempts to inflict poison on all enemies.
Poison.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of poisoning all enemies.

Torpor.name: Torpor
Torpor.description: Attempts to inflict sleep on all enemies.
Torpor.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of putting all enemies to sleep.

EvilEye.name: Evil Eye
EvilEye.description: Attempts to inflict fear on all enemies.
EvilEye.descriptionInGame: Evil gaze that has a chance of terrifying all enemies.

Paralysis.name: Paralysis
Paralysis.description: Attempts to inflict paralysis on all enemies.
Paralysis.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of paralyzing all enemies.

Corrupt.name: Corrupt
Corrupt.description: Attempts to inflict curse on all enemies.
Corrupt.descriptionInGame: Curse with a chance of giving all enemies cursed status.

Suicide.name: Suicide
Suicide.description: Targets one enemy at the start of the turn. If that enemy is inflicted with fear, they will attack themselves a number of times.
Suicide.descriptionInGame: Commands a terrified enemy to take its own life.

Betrayal.name: Betrayal
Betrayal.description: Targets one enemy at the start of the turn. If that enemy is inflicted with fear, they will attack a random enemy once.
Betrayal.descriptionInGame: Commands a terrified enemy to attack its own comrades.

Paralyze.name: Paralyze
Paralyze.description: Targets one enemy at the start of the turn. If that enemy is inflicted with fear, they will do nothing for the turn.
Paralyze.descriptionInGame: Commands a terrified enemy to remain motionless.

Revenge.name: Revenge
Revenge.description: Deals ranged untyped damage to one enemy based on how much HP the Hexer is missing.
Revenge.descriptionInGame: Uses the amount of HP lost as the basis for a single-enemy attack.

Take-H.name: Take
Take-H.description: Gather plants for materials at item points.
Take-H.descriptionInGame: Gather plants for materials at item points.

Caprice.name: Force: Caprice
Caprice.description: Attempts to inflict every single status ailment at once on all enemies. How this skill works is that there is a priority system in place. First, the skill tries to inflict stun. Afterward, whether the attempt was successful or not, the skill then attempts to inflict all status ailments in this order: Instant death > Petrify > Fear > Curse > Poison > Sleep > Confuse > Paralyze > Blind. The game will continue checking for each status effect until one is applied, or none get applied, and repeats the process for the next enemy. If poison is the ailment chosen, it will deal 350 poison damage. Has an infliction rate of 95%. Has a speed modifier of 500%.
Caprice.descriptionInGame: The cursed bell's chime inflicts multiple ailments on all enemies.

EscUp-G.name: Esc Up
EscUp-G.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-G.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

GunMastery.name: Gun Mastery
GunMastery.description: Needed to learn gun skills. Passively increases damage dealt with guns.

2-Hit-G.name: 2-Hit
2-Hit-G.description: Normal weapon attacks have a chance of hitting twice.
2-Hit-G.descriptionInGame: Normal weapon attacks have a chance of hitting twice.

Weakshot.name: Weakshot
Weakshot.description: Passively increases the chance that a normal attack will become a critical hit. The chance from this passive is added onto the Gunner's critical hit rate.
Weakshot.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of critical attacks with a normal weapon.

Legshot.name: Legshot
Legshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict leg bind.
Legshot.descriptionInGame: Gunshot with a chance of binding the enemy's legs.

Armshot.name: Armshot
Armshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict arm bind.
Armshot.descriptionInGame: Gunshot with a chance of binding the enemy's arms.

Headshot.name: Headshot
Headshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict Head bind.
Headshot.descriptionInGame: Gunshot with a chance of binding the enemy's head.

Riskshot.name: Riskshot
Riskshot.description: At the start of the turn, the Gunner prepares to deal ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Until they fire the shot, they will take extra damage from all attacks.
Riskshot.descriptionInGame: Sacrifice defense until the powerful piercing round is fired.

Stunshot.name: Stunshot
Stunshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict stun.
Stunshot.descriptionInGame: Fire a piercing round that may stun its target.

Snipe.name: Snipe
Snipe.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to one enemy. Cannot miss under any circumstances, even if the Gunner has their head bound or is blind.
Snipe.descriptionInGame: Piercing gunshot 100% guaranteed to hit its target.

Fireshot.name: Fireshot
Fireshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Fire damage to one enemy.

Riskfire.name: Riskfire
Riskfire.description: At the start of the turn, the Gunner prepares to deal ranged STR-based Fire damage to one enemy. Until they fire the shot, they will take extra damage from all attacks.
Riskfire.descriptionInGame: Sacrifice defense until the powerful flame round is fired.

Iceshot.name: Iceshot
Iceshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Ice damage to one enemy.

Riskice.name: Riskice
Riskice.description: At the start of the turn, the Gunner prepares to deal ranged STR-based Ice damage to one enemy. Until they fire the shot, they will take extra damage from all attacks.
Riskice.descriptionInGame: Sacrifice defense until the powerful glacial round is fired.

Voltshot.name: Voltshot
Voltshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Volt damage to one enemy.

Riskvolt.name: Riskvolt
Riskvolt.description: At the start of the turn, the Gunner prepares to deal ranged STR-based Volt damage to one enemy. Until they fire the shot, they will take extra damage from all attacks.
Riskvolt.descriptionInGame: Sacrifice defense until the powerful thunder round is fired.

Wildshot.name: Wildshot
Wildshot.description: Deals ranged STR-based Stab damage to all enemies.
Wildshot.descriptionInGame: Fire piercing bullets at all enemies.

Ricochet.name: Ricochet
Ricochet.description: Deals several instances of ranged STR-based Stab damage to random enemies. Can hit the same enemy multiple times. The targets are predetermined when the Gunner attacks.
Ricochet.descriptionInGame: Fire randomly at the enemy party.

Medishot.name: Medishot
Medishot.description: Dispels certain status ailments from the entire party. Cannot dispel petrification.
Medishot.descriptionInGame: Removes status ailments from the entire party.

Haltshot.name: Haltshot
Haltshot.description: Can only be used on the field. Any non-red FOEs within a certain range will be stunned for a set duration.
Haltshot.descriptionInGame: Stops FoE movement on the field for a limited time.

Take-G.name: Take
Take-G.description: Gather plants for materials at item points.
Take-G.descriptionInGame: Gather plants for materials at item points.

RiotGun.name: Force: Riot Gun
RiotGun.description: Attempts to inflict every single status ailment at once on all enemies. How this skill works is that there is a priority system in place. First, the skill tries to inflict stun. Afterward, whether the attempt was successful or not, the skill then attempts to inflict all status ailments in this order: Instant death > Petrify > Fear > Curse > Poison > Sleep > Confuse > Paralyze > Blind. The game will continue checking for each status effect until one is applied, or none get applied, and repeats the process for the next enemy. If poison is the ailment chosen, it will deal 350 poison damage. Has an infliction rate of 95%. Has a speed modifier of 500%.
RiotGun.descriptionInGame: A focused, powerful gunshot that will definitely stun an enemy.

EscUp-W.name: Esc Up
EscUp-W.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-W.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

WarEdge.name: War Edge
WarEdge.description: Needed to learn sword skills. Passively increases damage dealt with swords.

WarLore.name: War Lore
WarLore.description: Needed to learn healing skills. Passively increases the amount of HP restored through non-fixed sources.
WarLore.descriptionInGame: Needed to learn shaman and healing skills.

Regenall.name: Regenall
Regenall.description: Passively restores the entire party's HP at the end of each turn.
Regenall.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of HP to the party on every turn.

Blindcut.name: Blindcut
Blindcut.description: Deals melee STR-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. If the enemy is inflicted with blind, they have a chance to be inflicted with head bind/leg bind/arm bind.
Blindcut.descriptionInGame: Sword attack that binds the head of a blinded enemy.

Venomcut.name: Venomcut
Venomcut.description: Deals melee STR-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. If the enemy is inflicted with poison, they have a chance to be inflicted with head bind/leg bind/arm bind.
Venomcut.descriptionInGame: Sword attack that binds the legs of a poisoned enemy.

Sleepcut.name: Sleepcut
Sleepcut.description: Deals melee STR-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. If the enemy is inflicted with sleep, they will take extra damage.
Sleepcut.descriptionInGame: Sword attack that does increased damage to a sleeping enemy.

Fearcut.name: Fearcut
Fearcut.description: Deals melee STR-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. If the enemy is inflicted with fear, the War Magus is healed for a portion of the damage they deal.
Fearcut.descriptionInGame: Sword attack that drains HP when attacking a terrified enemy.

Stuncut.name: Stuncut
Stuncut.description: Deals melee STR-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. If the enemy is inflicted with paralysis, they have a chance to be inflicted with head bind/leg bind/arm bind.
Stuncut.descriptionInGame: Sword attack that binds the arms of a paralyzed enemy.

Cursecut.name: Cursecut
Cursecut.description: Deals melee STR-based untyped damage to one enemy. Has no damage type, so it ignores damage resistances altogether. If the enemy is inflicted with curse, the War Magus restores some TP equal to a portion of the damage they deal.
Cursecut.descriptionInGame: Sword attack that recovers TP when attacking a cursed enemy.

Cure-W.name: Cure
Cure-W.description: Restores a small amount of HP to one party member.
Cure-W.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of HP.

Healing-W.name: Healing
Healing-W.description: Restores a medium amount of HP to one party member.
Healing-W.descriptionInGame: Restores a medium amount of HP.

FullHeal-W.name: Full Heal
FullHeal-W.description: FRestores full HP to one party member.

Salve-W.name: Salve
Salve-W.description: Restores a small amount of HP to the entire party.
Salve-W.descriptionInGame: Restores a small amount of HP to the entire party.

Salve2-W.name: Salve 2
Salve2-W.description: Restores a medium amount of HP to the entire party.
Salve2-W.descriptionInGame: Restores a medium amount of HP to the entire party.

Warmight.name: Warmight
Warmight.description: Increases one party member's damage output for 5 turns. The damage buff is applied directly to the party members' base damage, so untyped attacks such as the Alchemist's Megido skill are also affected.
Warmight.descriptionInGame: Shaman spell that increases an ally's attack power.

Rockskin.name: Rockskin
Rockskin.description: Decreases the amount of damage one party member takes for 5 turns.
Rockskin.descriptionInGame: Shaman spell that increases an ally's defense.

Elkspeed.name: Elkspeed
Elkspeed.description: Increases one party member's AGI for 5 turns.
Elkspeed.descriptionInGame: Shaman spell that increases an ally's speed.

Erase.name: Erase
Erase.descriptionInGame: Shamanic spell that erases an enemy's status benefits.

Transfer.name: Transfer
Transfer.description: Spends some of the War Magus' TP to restore one party member's TP.
Transfer.descriptionInGame: Shamanic spell that transfers the war magus's TP to an ally.

Chop-W.name: Chop
Chop-W.description: Chop wood for materials at item points.
Chop-W.descriptionInGame: Chop wood for materials at item points.

Invoke.name: Force: Invoke
Invoke.description: Fully restores the entire party's HP and places a buff on the party that increases their resistances to all damage types, other than untyped, by 50% for 5 turns. Does not revive dead allies or dispels ailments or binds. Has a speed modifier of 200%.
Invoke.descriptionInGame: Restores the party's HP and boosts all elemental resistances.

EscUp-B.name: Esc Up
EscUp-B.description: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.
EscUp-B.descriptionInGame: Increase chances of successfully escaping from battle.

Loyalty.name: Loyalty
Loyalty.description: Passively gives the Beast a chance to take damage in another party member's place. Can activate multiple times per turn. When Loyalty activates, the defensive stats and buffs on the party member being defended get applied to the Beast, not their own. Has priority over the Protector's guarding skills, meaning that the Beast will take damage before those skills can mitigate them. Since this skill is a passive, it cannot be turned off once learned.
Loyalty.descriptionInGame: May take damage in the place of other party members.

Autocure.name: Autocure
Autocure.description: Passively restores a percentage of the Beast's max HP at the end of each battle.
Autocure.descriptionInGame: Restores a certain amount of HP after battle.

Autoheal.name: Autoheal
Autoheal.description: Passively gives the Beast a chance to recover from any status effects at the start of the turn. This is not related to Recover Chance.
Autoheal.descriptionInGame: May recover from various status ailments at the start of a turn.

EnGarde-B.name: En Garde
EnGarde-B.description: Passively gives the Beast a chance to reduce any instance of damage they take by 50%. Does not work with Loyalty activations.

Tenacity.name: Tenacity
Tenacity.description: If the Beast dies, this passive has a chance to revive them with 1 HP. Won't activate if the Beast is killed by instant death. Works with Loyalty activations.
Tenacity.descriptionInGame: May survive mortal blows with 1 HP remaining

Maul.name: Maul
Maul.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. The damage increases when the Beast's HP falls under certain thresholds.
Maul.descriptionInGame: Crushing attack whose damage increases as the beast's HP falls.

Devour.name: Devour
Devour.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. The Beast is healed for a portion of the damage they deal.
Devour.descriptionInGame: Bite down on an enemy to drain HP through the fangs.

Tackle.name: Tackle
Tackle.description: Deals melee STR-based Bash damage to one enemy. Has a chance to inflict stun.
Tackle.descriptionInGame: Powerful, striking tackle that may stun an enemy.

Rampage.name: Rampage
Rampage.description: Deals several instances of ranged STR-based Bash damage to random enemies. Can hit the same enemy multiple times. The targets are predetermined when the Beast attacks.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to one enemy.
Claw.descriptionInGame: Slash wildly at an enemy with both fore claws.

Wildcut.name: Wildcut
Wildcut.description: Deals melee STR-based Cut damage to all enemies.
Wildcut.descriptionInGame: Slash all enemies with dance-like moves.

Bristle.name: Bristle
Bristle.description: Increases the Beast's defenses against all damage types, but also lowers their damage output for 5 turns.
Bristle.descriptionInGame: Lowers offense to gain increased defense against all attacks.

Preen.name: Preen
Preen.description: Increases the Beast's physical defense and the chance of being targeted by enemies for 5 turns.
Preen.descriptionInGame: A bold display that increases physical defense and draws enemy attacks.

Wildwall.name: Wildwall
Wildwall.description: At the start of the turn, the Beast prepares to any damage they take from melee attacks (physical or elemental) for the current turn. Remains active until the turn ends or the Beast dies.
Wildwall.descriptionInGame: Await the enemy's attack to parry it and negate the damage.

BeastRoar.name: Beast Roar
BeastRoar.description: Attempts to inflict fear on all enemies.
BeastRoar.descriptionInGame: Roar that shakes the earth and terrifies all enemies.

Saliva.name: Saliva
Saliva.descriptionInGame: Lick an ally's wounds to restore their HP.

DozeOff.name: Doze Off
DozeOff.description: Restores the Beast's HP at the cost of putting them to sleep.
DozeOff.descriptionInGame: Fall asleep on the spot to restore a large amount of HP.

Howl.name: Howl
Howl.description: Can only be used on the field. Any non-red FOEs within a certain range will be lured to the tile this skill gets used on. Once they reach that tile, they will be stunned for a set duration.
Howl.descriptionInGame: A moaning howl that lures nearby FoEs to the spot where it's used.

Growl.name: Growl
Growl.description: Can only be used on the field. Any non-red FOEs within a certain range will be stunned for a set duration.
Growl.descriptionInGame: Stops FoE movement on the field for a limited time.

Fetch.name: Fetch
Fetch.description: Allows the party to gather from all kinds of item points a limited amount of times per day.
Fetch.descriptionInGame: Chop wood, mine ore, and gather plants at item points.

Salivall.name: Force: Salivall
Salivall.description: Heals and revives the entire party, along with dispelling any status ailments they have. Has no effect on binds or stuns. Has a base healing of 500. Has a speed modifier of 200%.
Salivall.descriptionInGame: Licks the party's wounds, restoring their HP and status.
